skill.displayName: AI Elf Generator – Create Magical Elf Characters & Elf on the Shelf Images – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI elf filter — transform a portrait into a fantasy elf character

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-elf-cli-skill.
- Transform portrait photos into fantasy elf characters using the WeShop CLI.
- Requires weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports custom prompts for elven style and batch image processing.
- Outputs generated images with status and direct URLs.
